# `<sl-description-list-item>` — description-list-item

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

A single label/value pair inside an [sl-description-list](description-list.md).

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/description-list-item/description-list-item.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | — | `string` | `''` | The item's label. If you need to display HTML, use the `label` slot instead. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The item's value. Can be plain text or richer content, e.g. an `<sl-tag>`. |
| `label` | The item's label. Alternatively, you can use the `label` attribute. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `label` | The container that wraps the label slot. |
| `value` | The container that wraps the value. |
